decisions.reason: As a 2023 flagship substrate platform that fits the firm's strategy toward higher-value semiconductor packaging, it still offers strategic upside and learning value at a likely manageable continuation cost despite limited visible proof of market take-up so far.

Because this 2024 flagship laser-structuring offering is very new, closely tied to the firm's core processing know-how, and aimed at growing advanced semiconductor applications, management would likely keep the option open while uncertainty resolves.
